item.title: Best Black Friday Nespresso Deals: Save 35-40% on Almost Everything (2026)
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-trimmed version. An LLM deleted boilerplate sentences from the original article and left the rest verbatim. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: Promotional content, not original reporting

If you’re trying to save time or money on coffee In This Economy™ this is your sign to take advantage of the Early Black Friday Nespresso deals. Nespresso machines not only make the best coffee and espresso-style shots you can get from a pod machine, they also happen to make great gifts for the under-caffeinated people in your life who are just never going to go full espresso maker. And right now you can save up to 40% on a Nespresso machine, including the high-end models that make legit cappuccinos and lattes.

Our favorite Nespresso deals

But with so many styles and models of Nespresso’s high-quality espresso and coffee-machines to choose from—and nearly as many early Black Friday sales clogging your feed—trying to decide what machine to buy can be overwhelming. Not only do you want to make sure you’re getting the best Nespresso machine for you (or your lucky giftee), you also want to make sure you’re getting the lowest price possible during this seasonal sale.

If you’re new to Nespresso, the main thing you need to know is that there are two lines of machines: The Original Line (often written as OriginalLine) and the Vertuo Line (sometimes written as Verutoline). You need, expectedly, Original capsules for Original machines and Vertuo capsules for Vertuo machines. I've broken down the differences between the lines below, and the defining details about specific models in each line that are on sale right now. And be sure to bookmark this story because we’ll update it with more Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals on Nespresso coffee makers and espresso machines as they happen.

Black Friday deals on Nespresso Vertuo machines

Introduced in 2014, Nespresso’s Vertuoline modernized the brand’s original pressure brew method and marked the true beginning of Nespresso espresso and coffee machines. Most Vertuo machines feature just one button and brew both coffee and espresso-style shots using a centrifugal method. Once you choose your preferred pod based on style, roast, and cup size, the machine takes care of the rest. That’s because the rim of every dome-shaped Vertuo capsule features a barcode that tells the Nespresso Vertuo machine how much water and what extraction speed to use for each pod—and can brew everything from a single and double espresso shot to a 14-ounce cup of coffee. Some Vertuo machines can even fill an 18-ounce carafe from a single coffee pod.

The very first Vertuo machine released more than a decade ago is still kicking, and it's one of the best values you can get.

Enabled with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity, the Nespresso Vertuo Next can brew 18 ounces of coffee from a single pod. If you’re intrigued by the tech or pod yield, it’s worth a try—especially considering Nespresso’s 30-day return policy, warranty, and reputation for maintenance and machine repairs.

Modeled on the Vertuo Next, this compact cutie is one of the newer Vertuo machines. It’s perfect for someone who’s short on space but still wants the convenience of the Vertuoline. The Pop Plus machines have slightly bigger water reservoirs than the Pop models, and they can hold more used capsules, but all of the machines have small-kitchen-friendly footprints.

Released earlier this year, the Vertuo Up is Nespresso's newest machine, and brews the one-touch Vertuo pods. This compact machine heats up in just three seconds (which, is really, really, ridiculously fast for any coffee maker to heat water) and depending on the specific model you get, it can brew six or seven different cup sizes, ranging from a single shot of espresso to a full carafe from a single Vertuo pod. Like the Next and Pop machines, the Vertuo Up is Wi-Fi enabled and you can use the companion app for maintenance alerts and to customize how the machine brews your favorite pods, if you'd like tweaks to the pod-specific presets.

The Vertuo Creatista is the first machine in the Vertuo line with a built-in steam wand. It’s not quite a one-touch cappuccino machine because brewing espresso from a pod and steaming the milk are two separate processes. But if you want the look of a real espresso machine (well, if you don’t look too closely) with the convenience of Nespresso Vertuo capsules, the Vertuo Creatista is a great option. This is the machine that I’ve been using at home for years and it works sort of like a super-automatic espresso machine.

The newest Vertuo machine, the Vertuo Lattissima is a one-touch machine that makes coffee, espresso, cappuccinos, and latte macchiatos at the push of a button.

Black Friday deals on OriginalLine Nespresso machines

Until the Vertuoline was introduced in 2014, the OriginalLine machines were simply known as Nespresso machines. These models brew either single or lungo (Italian for "long") espresso-style shots from any compatible pod using a pressure-driven method. The Original Line features a collection of compact pod-only machines (Nespresso CitiZ, Nespresso Essenza Mini, and Nespresso Pixie) as well as a variety of pricier Creatista and Lattissima models, with built-in steam wands or other automatic milk frothers. We rarely see the compact Original machines go on sale, but here are the Nespresso Original Line models you can find for a steal ahead of Black Friday.

These one-touch espresso and latte machines make a variety of one-touch milk drinks and have built-in milk cleaning functions that do a lot (but not all) of the daily maintenance so you don’t have to.
